title: docs(tutorials): add complete uninstall and cleanup guide
body:
## What does this PR do?

Adds a comprehensive tutorial guide (`docs/tutorials/uninstall.md`) explaining how to completely reset, purge, and uninstall Podman, its virtual machines, container storage, networks, and configuration files across Linux, macOS, and Windows. Also updates `docs/tutorials/README.md` to link the new guide.

## Why?

Users seeking a clean re-installation, version downgrade/upgrade, or complete software removal previously lacked documented commands and paths for residual files and directories.

Fixes #18034

## Testing

Verified rendered markdown formatting, code block syntax, and internal documentation links.

comments.body: Thanks  @Honny1 for the detailed review. I agree that manually removing installed binaries is not the right approach. I'll revise the guide to document only supported installation methods, remove the manual binary deletion steps, and align the platform-specific uninstall instructions with the existing Podman/Podman Desktop documentation.

Thanks for the review. I've revised the tutorial to address the concerns:

Removed manual binary/file deletion instructions.
Removed Homebrew, unsupported package-manager, and winget instructions.
Limited package installation/uninstallation instructions to the supported methods.
Updated VM cleanup to use podman machine reset -f.
Kept the reset and optional leftover-data cleanup sections separate.
Updated the tutorials index to match the revised scope.

I also reviewed the remaining cleanup instructions to avoid undocumented manual system-file removal.
